name: real_v1
description: Dependency graph of 18 US companies, 4 commodities (wti, henry_hub, copper, gold), and the S&P 500 market index. Structure from BEA 2023 input-output tables (threshold 2%), commodity exposure, and manual CapEx AI hardware links; weights from daily log-return OLS (2021-2023).
weak_weights_policy: Economically justified edges with |t| < 2 are retained in the graph so valuer agents hold the full structural belief set; their justification explicitly records the insignificant t-statistic. When two parent companies in the same BEA industry correlate strongly (COP/EOG and VLO/MPC return correlations ~0.88), OLS splits their common effect across both parents (e.g. VLO -> DAL 0.130 + MPC -> DAL 0.136 = 0.266; COP -> VLO 0.538 + EOG -> VLO 0.178 = 0.716), so a borderline individual |t| < 2 reflects collinearity rather than a weak economic link. Economically spurious or intra-industry competitor edges (including questionable 22 -> 331 utilities -> primary metals, where interest-rate-driven utility stocks produce negative weights on NUE/AA) are dropped during structure selection.
start_price_source: stocks_close_raw (Yahoo Finance close adjusted for splits only, not dividends)
